This a code to fit Bayesian multilevel mixed effect model to the pupil metrics (mean pupil size, maximum pupil size and rate of pupil change)  


```{r}
#|label: laod-data
#|include: false
data_pupil_mean <- read_csv(here("data/pupil_metrics/mean_pid.csv"))
data_pupil_max <- read_csv(here("data/pupil_metrics/max_pid.csv"))
data_pupil_rate <- read_csv(here("data/pupil_metrics/rate_pid.csv"))

#Wrangle
data_pupil <- data_pupil_mean |>
  mutate(pupil_mean = mean,
         pupil_max = data_pupil_max$mean,
         pupil_rate = data_pupil_rate$mean_pupil_change) |>
  select(pid, condition, accuracy, pupil_mean, pupil_max, pupil_rate) |>
  mutate(accuracy = factor(accuracy, levels = c(1, 0),
                           labels = c("correct", "incorrect"))) |>
  rename(cond = condition, acc = accuracy) |>
  mutate(int_cond = factor(paste(cond, acc, sep = "_"),
                           levels = c("Learned_correct", "Learned_incorrect",
                                      "Novel_correct", "Novel_incorrect"))) |>
  select(pid, int_cond, pupil_mean, pupil_max, pupil_rate)

```

```{r}
#|label: model-function
#|indlude: false
library(brms)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)

metrics <- c("pupil_mean", "pupil_max", "pupil_rate")  # replace with your column names

data_pupl <- data_pupil %>%
  mutate(int_cond = factor(int_cond,
    levels = c("Learned_correct", "Learned_incorrect", "Novel_correct", "Novel_incorrect")))

fit_metric <- function(metric) {
  # Standardise so the same weakly-informative priors suit every metric
  d <- data_pupil %>% mutate(y = as.numeric(scale(.data[[metric]])))

  brm(
    formula = bf(y ~ 0 + int_cond + (1 | pid)),
    data    = d,
    family  = gaussian(),
    prior   = c(
      prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),        # cell means on the z scale
      prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),     # participant SD
      prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
    ),
    chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
    seed = 2026,
    file = paste0("models/fit_", metric)
  )
}

fits <- set_names(map(metrics, fit_metric), metrics)
```

```{r}
#|label: model-contrasts
#|indlude: false
contrasts <- c(
  "Familiarity (Learned - Novel)" =
    "(int_condLearned_correct + int_condLearned_incorrect)/2 - (int_condNovel_correct + int_condNovel_incorrect)/2 = 0",
  "Accuracy (Correct - Incorrect)" =
    "(int_condLearned_correct + int_condNovel_correct)/2 - (int_condLearned_incorrect + int_condNovel_incorrect)/2 = 0",
  "Interaction" =
    "(int_condLearned_correct - int_condLearned_incorrect) - (int_condNovel_correct - int_condNovel_incorrect) = 0"
)

map(fits, ~ hypothesis(.x, contrasts))

contrasts_dir <- sub("= 0", "> 0", contrasts)
map(fits, ~ hypothesis(.x, contrasts_dir))
```
